title: EchoRec: Multi-Item Prediction-Empowered Generative Recommendation via Cycle-Consistent Preference Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.14011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation autoregressively generates the semantic IDs of the target item, unifying preference modeling and index retrieval within the shared token space. Recent attempts have introduced Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) into this field, yet they primarily inherit its efficiency merit, leaving its potential as dense supervision unexplored. Unlocking this potential hinges on whether future behaviors qualify as informative supervision. Our analysis reveals that future behaviors carry a semantic echo of the current one far above that of random pairs, which nevertheless decays along horizons under intent transitions, making them informative yet order-dependent signals. Motivated by this, we propose EchoRec, which empowers MTP with cycle-consistent holistic preference alignment across multi-horizon for generative recommendation. It comprises two synergistic modules. translated_title: EchoRec：通过循环一致性偏好对齐实现的多项目预测增强生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐在共享令牌空间中自回归生成目标项目的语义ID，统一了偏好建模和索引检索。最近的尝试将多令牌预测（MTP）引入该领域，但主要继承了其效率优势，未探索其作为密集监督的潜力。释放这一潜力取决于未来行为是否具备信息性监督的资格。我们的分析显示，未来行为携带当前行为的语义回响，远高于随机对，但在意图转换下沿时间范围衰减，使其成为信息丰富但顺序依赖的信号。基于此，我们提出EchoRec，通过跨多时间范围的循环一致性整体偏好对齐来增强MTP，用于生成式推荐。它包含两个协同模块：时间范围感知偏好生成（HPG）顺序链接语义，以及偏好一致性对齐（PCA）确保循环一致性，以增强监督信号并提升推荐性能。
tldr: EchoRec通过循环一致性偏好对齐和多项目预测，充分利用未来行为作为密集监督信号，显著提升生成式推荐的准确性和鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: EchoRec leverages cycle-consistent preference alignment and multi-item prediction to exploit future behaviors as dense supervision, significantly enhancing generative recommendation accuracy and robustness.
